# Acme invoice-rules agent guidance

This repository implements the Acme invoice-rules service. Architecture authority: docs/adr/001-service-boundaries.md.

## Commands
Run from the repository root.
- pnpm lint — read-only and offline.
- pnpm test — offline; writes only .tmp/tests.
- Obtain approval before pnpm test:integration or pnpm generate.
- Do not run pnpm release without Release Manager authorization.

## Boundaries
- packages/api may depend on packages/domain; reverse is forbidden.
- Do not hand-edit src/gen/**; source is schema/invoice.yaml.
- Follow docs/security/change-policy.md for approval-gated changes.

## Maintenance
Platform owns this file. Review it when command effects, runtime precedence, the ADR, or security policy changes. Remove it by deleting AGENTS.md and the @AGENTS.md adapter in CLAUDE.md together.
